# `valueConfigs`: the dropdown value configs

Part of [generated data](../generated-data.md). `makeValueConfigs` must keep its `const` type parameter (the rule: [`src/01_SpreadsheetSchema/AGENTS.md`](../../src/01_SpreadsheetSchema/AGENTS.md)).

## How `valueConfigs` is generated

**`valueConfigs`** (`generated/valueConfigs.ts`) — generated by `ValueConfigOperator` (`05_Operators`) from the **value sources** in use, once `columnConfigs` is already synced. It asks Column Config for the distinct value sources its dropdown columns name, fetches each source column in full on its own Table, and emits one entry per source under its value name. Each is a fixed list: blanks are dropped, duplicates collapse to their first position, and sheet order is kept. A source column with a declared value name types every member (`number` and `date` give numbers, `checkbox` booleans, `string` strings), while an untyped source keeps each member's own primitive. A value name equal to a framework value name, or taken by two different sources, fails the config sync, naming both. **`makeValueConfigs` takes a `const` type parameter, and must keep it** (#18): without it the generated member lists infer as `string[]` and every dropdown column's value type collapses to bare `string`, which silently removes the union a switch over a Value Config's members is meant to be exhaustive against. The generated file carries no `as const` of its own, so the constructor is the only thing holding the literals. Measured at ~41k instantiations — see [type-check cost](../architecture/type-check-cost.md).

## The two kinds

Each entry is one of two kinds, and the value type and value schema of every column naming it follow the kind (#145):

- **A fixed list** is an array of members, each a string, number or boolean. The `const` parameter keeps it a literal tuple, so its value type is the union of its members, a number member staying a number literal, and its wire type is the union of their primitive kinds. Its value schema accepts only a member, and its default is its first member.
- **A live reference** is the marker `{ "kind": "liveReference" }`, with no members, because its options are rows added after the build. Its value type is `string`, and it takes the framework `string` value schema: any string is accepted, and its default is blank, so the column's **Empty value allowed** decides whether that blank reads. It never takes the `id` value schema, whose default throws.

`ValueConfigOperator` emits every source as a fixed list, Name and ID sources included, until a later #144 ticket emits those as live references. Value Config is still on the config-sheet floor; as a Let api access Table it is one more value source, so its value names are `valueConfig<Header>`. The framework's `valueKinds/` test program installs a hand-written config set with one of each.
